class_inventory_from_200_test_clips.caveat: 200 of 1,125 clips; the tail classes are small enough that this is a rough count
class_inventory_from_200_test_clips.imbalance: LANE_KEEP is 88.5 percent; four of the six classes are under 3 percent each

flip_mapping_now_determinable.unit_test_required: a double flip must return the original class

findings.practical_reading: a command branch would be trained on a signal that is LANE_KEEP nearly nine times out of ten, so the contrast has to be read on the turning and lane-change rows as well as on overall D3

train_and_test_do_not_carry_the_same_com.consequence: vad_cmd exists only on the test side. Using it as an input would mean reproducing the organisers' reduction rule for training, which is not verified anywhere. The six-class command string exists on both sides and is the only field matchable without inventing that rule.
train_and_test_do_not_carry_the_same_com.join_required: train commands must be matched to each anchor frame by timestamp

test.meaning: the command at the current frame, already reduced

train.meaning: a per-frame series; there is no vad_cmd column

flip_mapping_requirement.issue: the training augmentation mirrors the ego frame about y = 0, so any left/right command class has to be swapped in the same item, and a double flip must return the original class

input_boundary_if_used.allowed_form: shared scene-feature conditioning only, as a small zero-init residual on the scene query context, mirroring how goal is used
input_boundary_if_used.control_design: CMD0 versus CMD1 must carry the identical module and parameter count, differing only in whether the slots hold the real command or null, so capacity is not the contrast
forbidden: command into the ego-state head or waypoint queries
filling a missing command from ground-truth future motion

purpose: pre-specification fact-find for a command experiment; no experiment started

test_set.note: one row per clip: the command at the current frame, not a per-frame series
